prompt:
Create one landscape 3:2 Minecraft architectural MOOD BOARD on a plain warm light background, crisp vanilla voxel rendering, for "WEST CRISSY FIELD / PRESIDIO". No characters, villagers, animals, vehicles or Golden Gate Bridge inside any module. This is a public Minecraft Java 1.21.1 catalog concept sheet. Use only actual vanilla 1.21.1 blocks, no pale oak. Save the image as moodboard.png if possible.

Layout: four small isometric thumbnail takes across the upper two thirds, each a whole coordinated collection of the historic west Crissy Field Army and Coast Guard buildings, recognisably the same real place. Caption them "01 ARMY WAREHOUSES", "02 MILITARY ROW", "03 COAST GUARD SHORE", "04 COMPLETE KIT". Emphasize different roof and massing studies while retaining the identity and site orientation of each building; do not rotate buildings for alternate layouts. The complete kit thumbnail shows all ten distinct modules. Below, a clean strip of block swatches grouped by role, with exact readable namespaced Minecraft block IDs under each cube. Bottom row: four enlarged voxel detail callouts captioned "WAREHOUSE WINDOW + SLIDING DOOR", "GREEN TRIM + PORCH EAVE", "LOOKOUT CUPOLA + FLAG", "NORTH-FACING BOATHOUSE DOOR". Elegant legible architectural board typography, generous spacing, no overlapping labels.

Character: tidy low historic US military post beside San Francisco Bay, white painted wood and cream stucco, red and grey roofs, dark green trim, lawns, restrained paths and flagpole. The orange Golden Gate is contextual inspiration only: omit bridge from all modules and board. No invented towers except the small station lookout cupola. Buildings must look compact at 0.5 blocks per metre, a normal storey about 2 blocks. Every plot has flat 1-block smooth stone ground at y0; grass or paths only on open cells. Include discreet lantern lighting at entrances and under eaves to suggest spawn-safe interiors.

Ten modules left to right in their fixed plot sequence: 0 large tall single-storey Army warehouse/climbing gym, 29x39 max y10, irregular stepped angled footprint, white walls, rhythmic tall multipane windows, broad dark grey or muted red gable, sliding doors and modest sign band; 1 long two-storey cream Mission Revival Army building, 28x23 max y10, angled stepped walls, red hipped tile-like roof, paired windows; 2 sister two-storey white siding Army building, 27x20 max y10, grey gable and front porch; 3 long narrow cream swim-school storehouse, 14x36 max y9, slightly diagonal stepped lengthwise walls, low red gable ridge along its length and loading doors; 4 tiny two-storey white office, 10x11 max y8, hip roof; 5 single-storey bike workshop, 11x9 max y7, broad storefront and green awning; 6 1915 Colonial Revival Coast Guard visitor station, 13x12 max y10, stepped diagonal footprint, white clapboard, red roof, dark green trim, small square lookout cupola and front flagpole with block-built red/white/blue US banner; 7 Ocean Climate Center, 8x8 max y8, white clapboard red hip roof; 8 white garage, 9x9 max y6, red roof and wide door; 9 1890 little white wooden boathouse, 7x8 max y6, steep red roof, large water-facing door on NORTH side. Ground plots never overlap, nothing projects beyond plot edges, eaves kept within walls/plot. North = low z, east = high x; show a small compass. Water can be suggested outside the thumbnails as a pale blue contextual line, not as extra module geometry.

Footprints are fixed, not generic rectangles. These masks are coarse 2x2-block occupancy, clipped to stated plot dimensions, # building and . open ground; follow regular staircase diagonal walls and roof ridges on long axes. Mask rows top to bottom north to south:

Swatches with EXACT labels, grouped by role:
WALLS: minecraft:white_concrete, minecraft:smooth_sandstone, minecraft:birch_planks.

Render genuine Minecraft block texture and cubic stairs, panes, fences, doors and banners; no smooth non-voxel architectural surfaces. reads: A tidy waterfront military post with low white and cream buildings, lawns, and orderly paths.
A dominant white warehouse with a broad grey gable, tall multipane windows, and green sliding doors.
Cream two-storey Army buildings with red hipped roofs and repeated paired windows.
White siding, grey gables, and sheltered front porches on the sister Army buildings.
A long narrow storehouse with a red gabled roof and repeated door openings.
Dark green porch beams, window trim, doors, and the bike shop awning.
A white Coast Guard station with a red roof, square lookout cupola, and US flag.
Small red-roofed coastal outbuildings, including the steep-roof boathouse with its wide green waterfront door.
Lantern-lit entrances and eaves, shown alongside labeled vanilla block swatches.
